meta.title: TrekPilot demo
meta.description: A WordPress site with TrekPilot installed and one sample trek with a departure city, dates, pricing and a pickup point.
meta.author: vastarpara

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;
\TrekPilot\Includes\Database::create_tables();
update_option( 'trekpilot_currency_symbol', '$' );
update_option( 'trekpilot_payment_method', 'cash' );

$trek_id = wp_insert_post( array(
	'post_type'    => 'trekpilot_trek',
	'post_status'  => 'publish',
	'post_title'   => 'Kedarkantha Winter Trek',
	'post_excerpt' => 'A memorable easy-grade winter trek in Uttarakhand with snow trails, camping and summit views.',
	'post_content' => 'Walk through pine forests and frozen meadows to the Kedarkantha summit at sunrise.',
) );

$p = $wpdb->prefix;
$wpdb->insert( $p . 'trekpilot_treks', array(
	'post_id'       => $trek_id,
	'difficulty'    => 'Easy',
	'duration'      => '6 Days / 5 Nights',
	'altitude'      => '12500 ft',
	'region'        => 'Uttarakhand',
	'season'        => 'December - April',
	'distance'      => '20 km',
	'fitness_level' => 'Good',
	'age_limit'     => '12 to 60 Years',
	'group_size'    => '15 Trekkers',
	'highlights'    => "Summit at sunrise\nSnow camping\nPine forest trails",
) );

$wpdb->insert( $p . 'trekpilot_departure_cities', array(
	'trek_id'          => $trek_id,
	'city_name'        => 'Dehradun',
	'base_price'       => 7999,
	'offer_price'      => 6999,
	'transport_type'   => 'Shared Tempo Traveller',
	'reporting_time'   => '06:00 AM',
	'booking_deadline' => 2,
	'status'           => 'active',
	'menu_order'       => 1,
) );
$city_id = $wpdb->insert_id;

$wpdb->insert( $p . 'trekpilot_pickup_points', array(
	'city_id'       => $city_id,
	'trek_id'       => $trek_id,
	'location_name' => 'Dehradun Railway Station',
	'pickup_time'   => '06:00 AM',
	'instructions'  => 'Meet the trek leader at the main gate.',
	'menu_order'    => 1,
) );

$wpdb->insert( $p . 'trekpilot_pricing', array(
	'city_id'           => $city_id,
	'date_id'           => 0,
	'trek_id'           => $trek_id,
	'adult_price'       => 7999,
	'child_price'       => 6499,
	'offer_price'       => 6999,
	'group_discount'    => wp_json_encode( array( array( 'min_seats' => 5, 'type' => 'percent', 'value' => 10 ) ) ),
	'extra_charges'     => wp_json_encode( array( array( 'name' => 'Forest permit', 'price' => 250, 'type' => 'person' ) ) ),
	'optional_addons'   => wp_json_encode( array( array( 'name' => 'Rental Trekking Pole', 'price' => 300, 'type' => 'person', 'desc' => 'For the whole trek' ) ) ),
	'transport_options' => wp_json_encode( array( array( 'name' => 'Shared Tempo Traveller', 'price' => 0 ), array( 'name' => 'Private SUV', 'price' => 2500 ) ) ),
) );

foreach ( array( 21, 35 ) as $days_ahead ) {
	$wpdb->insert( $p . 'trekpilot_departure_dates', array(
		'city_id'        => $city_id,
		'trek_id'        => $trek_id,
		'departure_date' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+' . $days_ahead . ' days' ) ),
		'status'         => 'open',
	) );
	$wpdb->insert( $p . 'trekpilot_availability', array(
		'date_id'         => $wpdb->insert_id,
		'total_seats'     => 15,
		'booked_seats'    => 0,
		'available_seats' => 15,
	) );
}

flush_rewrite_rules();
